name: turbo-surf
description: Native-speed, browserless web crawler + MCP server for AI agents. A standalone Rust engine (turbo-dom + a V8 JS-render tier) — fetch + parse + extract + run page JS with no headless browser. This npm package is a thin launcher that spawns the native binary.

scripts.test:shim: node --test --test-force-exit --test-timeout=300000 --test-concurrency=1 rust/playwright-shim/test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/surface.test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/screenshot-assets.test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/runtime-locator.test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/dom-traversal.test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/idle-callback.test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/small-behavior.test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/lifecycle.test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/navigation.test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/eval-input.test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/routing-regressions.test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/context-cookie.test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/style-resources.test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/cli-entry.test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/storage-state.test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/request-events.test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/request-navigation.test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/redirect-responses.test.mjs  rust/playwright-shim/screenshot-resources.test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/screenshot-options.test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/screenshot-scene.test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/native-profile.test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/native-peer-events.test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/input-hardware.test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/config.test.mjs rust/playwright-shim/skip-isolation.test.mjs
scripts.test:playwright: npm run build:addon && timeout --signal=KILL 600 npm run test:shim && timeout --signal=KILL 600 npm run test:e2e
scripts.test: python3 scripts/check-versions.py && bash scripts/check-single-v8.sh && python3 -B scripts/test_smoke_mcp_release.py && python3 -B scripts/test_check_coverage_floors.py && python3 -B scripts/test_coverage_shard.py && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s rust/release-deps -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s rust/release-deps/deno -p 'test_*.py' && python3 scripts/sync-third-party-notices.py --check && python3 harness/detection/verify-audio-sources.py && (cd rust && cargo test --workspace && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --check) && npm run test:playwright && npm run test:detection
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.test:detection: node --test --test-concurrency=1 harness/detection/*.test.mjs && python3 -B harness/detection/engine-155/test_async_admission_helper.py && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s harness/detection/engine-154 -p 'test_*.py'
